book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusi Paththida Mato Halaqaza Ashkaraza
Yesusi hessa wursika dere sinththan yooti wursidaappe guye Qifirnahoome gizaso bi gelides.
Heen Qifirnahoomen mato halaqay dees; he addezas izi siiqiza ashkaray hargidi hayqos shempo bolla dees.
Izikka Yesusa gishshas siyidi, «Ba ashkaraa paththana mala Yesusa woosseriketii!» giidi issi issi Ayhuda bagga asatappe cimata Yesusaakko yeddides.
Kiitettidi bida asati Yesusaakko yiidi, «Hayssa addeza gishshas ne ashkaraza paththana bessees.
Ays giikko hayssi addezi nu asaa daro dosees; nuuska Ayhuda Woosa Keeththe keexisiday iza» giidi minththi woossida.

Yesusikka isttara bides. Yesusi addeza keeththaako matiza wode addezi ba laggeta Yesusaakko yeddidi, «Godoo! Ne ta keeththe gelanaas bessenna; tanikka nena ta keeththe gelththanaas bessiza as gidontta gishshas haa yashe daaburoppa.
Tani ne sinththan beettanaas bessontta as gidida gishshas neekko babeekke; hessa gishshas neni heen daada qaala xalla giikko ta ashkaray paxana.

Taaska tana azaziza asi taappe bollara dees. Taappe garsara tani azaziza wottadarati deettes. Issaa, ‹Haa ya!› giikko yees; issaa, ‹Hee ba!› giikko bees; ashkaraykka, ‹Hessa ooththa!› giikko azazettidayssa ooththees» gides.

Yesusikka addezi gidayssa siyidi addeza hanoteththaan malalettides; guye simmidi bana kaalliza deraas, «Ta inttes gizay hayssa mala gita ammano haray attoshin Isra7eele nayta giddonkka demmabeekke» gides.
Yesusaakko kiitettida asati guye kiittida halaqazaso simmidi ashkarazi paxidayssa be7ida.
Yesusi Hayqoppe Paththida Am7ey Naaza
Hessafe guye Yesusi gam7ontta dishe Nayne geetettiza katama bana kaallizaytaranne daro derera issife bides.

Izi biidi katamaa geliza miixaa gakkishin he katamayppe daro asay aha tookki ekkidi kezi wodhdhides. Hayqqidayssi ba aayeys izi mexi issino. Aayeyska azinay baa; katamappe daro asay izira issife dees.
Godaykka izo be7ida wode izis mishettidi, «Aykkoy baa; yeekkofa!» gides.
Shiiqidi ahaa tookkida hala bochchiin ahaa tookkidayti sitti gi eqqida. Yesusikka, «Haysso naazoo nena gays denda!» gides.
Hayqqida naazikka suuri uttidi haasaya oykkides. Yesusikka naaza aayeys efi immides.
Asay wurikka keehi babbidi Xoossaa galatishe, «Gita nabey nu giddofe dendides; Xoossika hayssa dereza yiidi be7ides» gides.
Hayssi Yesusa gishshas haasayettiza lo7o haasayay kumeththa Yuhudaninne Yuhuda yuushon diza deretan kezides.
Xammaqiza Yohannisappe Yesusaakko Kiitettida Asata
Xammaqiza Yohannisa kaallizaytikka hayssa ubbaa Yohannisas yootida. Yohannisikka istta giddofe nam7ata xeygidi,
«Izi yaana geetettidi haasayettizayssi neneyee? Hara as naaginoo? gi oychchite» giidi Godaakko yeddides.
Bida asati Yesusaakko gakkidi, «Xammaqiza Yohannisi, ‹Izi yaana geetettidi haasayettizayssi neneyee? Hara as naaginoo?› giidi neekko nuna yeddides» gida.
He wode Yesusi daro asaa waayeppe, hargefenne tuna ayanatappe paththides. Daro qooqeta ayfeykka xeellides.

Yohannisi kiittiin izakko yidayta, «Biidi intte intte ayfera be7idayssanne siyidayssa Yohannisas yootite. Ayfe qooqeti xeelleettes; toho wobbeti suure hemetteettes; inchchirachcha hargizayti paxida; tulleti siyida; hayqqidayti hayqoppe dendida; manqotas Mishiraachcho qaalay yootettees.
Tanan dhuphettontta asi wurikka anjjettidayssa» gides.
Yohannisi kiittida asati Yesusa achchafe bidaappe guye Yesusi daro asaas Yohannisa gishshas, «Intte ay beyanaas bazzo kezidetii? Carkoy yaanne haa qaaseththiza shomboqo beyanaassee?
Ay beyanaas kezidetii? Lo7iza may7o may7ida as beyana kezidetii? Lo7o may7o may7idi warxi warxi gizayti ishalo duus dizayti kawo keeththan deettes.
Histtiko ay beyanaas kezidetii? Nabe beyanaassee? Ee ta inttes tuma gays; intte keziday nabeppe aadhdhizaade beyanaassa.
Xoossa qaalan, ‹Ne baana oge nees baasi lo7eththana kiitettida as ta neeppe sinththara yeddana› geetettidi iza gishshas xaafettidayssi izakko.
«Tani inttes gizay maccassafe yelettida asaa giddon Yohannisappe aadhdhizaadey oonikka deenna; Xoossa Kawoteththan gidikko as ubbaafe guuth geetettida asi Yohannisappe aadhdhana» gi yootides.
Qaraxa qanxxisizaytikka attontta hayssa Yesusa qaala siyidayti wurikka Yohannisa kushen xammaqettidi Xoossas bessiza bonchcho immida.
Farsaawetinne Muse wogaa eranchchati Yohannisa kushen xammaqettontta gishshas Xoossi isttas waanna qofa ooththidi shiishshidayssa hirayssida.
Qasseka Yesusi zaaridi, «Histtiko ha7i yeletaa aazan leemisoo? Istti ay misatizoo?
Giyan uttidi ba giddon issoy issaara xeygettidi, ‹Inttes nuni diith diixxidos shin duribeekketa; zilas zilalidos shin yeekkibeekketa giza nayta misateettes› gides.
Ays giikko Xammaqiza Yohannisi kath monttanne woyneppe oosettida cajje uyontta yiin, ‹Daydanththi iza bolla dees› gideta.
Asa nay qasse mishenne uyishe yiin, ‹Ganjamanne ushshanchcha, qaraxa shiishshizaytaranne nagaranchchatara laggetees› gideta.
Hessa gishshas erateththa tumateththay izi nayta ubbata achchan ammanettides» gides.
Yesusa Toho Shitto Tiyda Maccassayo
Hessafe guye Farsaawetappe issi asi quma maanaas Yesusa baso xeygiin Yesusi xeygida Farsaawezaso bi uttides.
He kataman diza issi nagaranchcha maccas dizaara Yesusi Farsaaweza keeththan quma maadda bollan dizayssa siyada issi albasxiroose bilqaaxe shitto ekka yadus.
Histtada Yesusappe guyera iza toho achchan eqqada yeekkashenne ba afunththan iza toho caphisada ba hu7e binanara quccashenne yeerashe shittoza tiyadus.

Yesusa qumas xeyssida Farsaaweykka hessa be7idi, «Hayssi addezi nabe gididaakko hanna iza bochchida maccassaya iza oonakkonne ay ooththiza asakko eranakkoshin; iza nagaranchchako shin» giidi ba wozinan qoppides.
Yesusi, «Simoona! Nees ta yootanaazi dees» gides. Simoonikka, «Astamaaree! Ero yoota» gides.
Yesusi zaaridi, «Issi miishshe tal7e immizaadefe tal7e ekkida nam7u asati deettes; isttafe issaa bolla ichchashu xeet dinaarey dees; nam7anththoza bolla ichchashu tammu dinaarey
dees.
Isttas qanxxiza miishshi dhayiin tal7e immidayssi nam7ata acoza ubbaaka maarides; histtiko ha nam7atappe ha tal7e immidayssa darssi dosanay awayssee?» gides.
Simoonikka zaaridi, «Daro acoy maarettidayssa gaada qoppays» gides. Yesusikka, «Tumu pirdadasa» gides.
He maccassayko yuuyidi Simoona, «Hanno maccassayo xeellay? Ta ne keeththe geliin ne ta tohos haaththe shiishshabeekka; iza gidikko ta toho ba afunththan caphisada ba hu7e binanara quccadus.
Neni ubbaaka tana yeerabeekka; iza gidikko ta geloosoppe doommada ta toho yeero aggabeekku.
Ne ta hu7e zayte tiyabeekka shin iza gidikko ta toho shitto tiyadus.
«Hessa gishshas ta nena gizay iza tana keeha dosida gishshas iza ba daro nagarappe maarettadus; guuththara maarettiza asa siiqoykka guuththa» gides.
Yesusi maccassayo, «Ne nagarappe maarettadasa» gides.
Izara issife maaddan uttida imaththatikka, «Hayssi nagara maarizay izi oonee?» giidi ba wozinara qoppida.
Yesusikka maccassayo, «Nena ne ammanoy ashshides; saron ba!» gides.

footnotes.text: Dinaare: Dinaarey he wode issi oosanchchas issi gallassa damoza.
